name: download-button
title: Download button
description: A download action that tells you what you get: file name, type and size on the button, and a preparing state for files made on demand.
docs: Give href for a file that exists (a real link; a cross-origin file may be opened instead of saved) or onDownload for one built when asked. Pass bytes as soon as you know the size; it can arrive after the first render. The accessible name follows the state and always holds the words drawn on the button.
